title: Four Allies Speak Up for Taiwan at the UN Climate Summit
summaryZh: 四友邦在COP31為台灣發聲，外交部致謝。
summaryHi: चार सहयोगी देशों ने COP31 जलवायु सम्मेलन में ताइवान की भागीदारी का समर्थन किया।
summaryEs: Cuatro aliados respaldan la participación de Taiwán en la cumbre climática COP31.
summaryJa: COP31で友好4カ国が台湾の参加を支持、外交部が感謝。
summaryKo: 4개 수교국이 COP31에서 대만 참여 지지, 외교부 감사.
summaryEn: Guatemala, Belize, Paraguay and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines backed Taiwan's role in UN climate talks at COP31.
paragraphs: Taiwan's government has thanked four diplomatic allies for backing its participation in global climate governance at COP31, the latest United Nations climate summit, which took place in Türkiye.

Excluded from the United Nations system, Taiwan relies on friendly nations to raise its case. Guatemala, Belize, Paraguay, and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines did so during the conference's high-level segment on November 17 and 18.

According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the four allies recognised Taiwan's progress in carbon pricing, emissions reduction, climate adaptation and clean technology. Guatemala's environment minister, Edwin Castellanos, said these measures demonstrated Taiwan's commitment to climate neutrality.

Saint Vincent and the Grenadines argued that an energy transition cannot be fair or inclusive if it leaves small island states behind or shuts out willing partners. Paraguay, in a written statement, said Taiwan had contributed to mitigation, adaptation and international cooperation and should be allowed to take part.
The ministry said the statements showed growing recognition of what Taiwan can offer, and it repeated that the island has made measurable progress towards sustainable development.
Taiwan said thank you to four friendly countries on Saturday. These countries helped Taiwan at a big United Nations meeting about the climate.
The meeting was called COP31. It was in Türkiye. Leaders from many countries talked about how to stop the planet from getting hotter.
Taiwan is not a member of the United Nations. It cannot join the meeting by itself. So its friends spoke for it.
The four countries are Guatemala, Belize, Paraguay, and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines. They said Taiwan is doing good work. It is cutting pollution and making clean technology.
Taiwan's foreign ministry was happy. It said Taiwan wants to help the world with climate problems.
sentZh: 台灣在週六向四個友好國家道謝。
這些國家在一場關於氣候的聯合國大型會議上幫助了台灣。
這場會議叫做COP31。
它在土耳其舉行。
許多國家的領袖討論如何阻止地球變得更熱。
台灣不是聯合國的會員。
它無法自己參加這場會議。
所以它的朋友替它發言。
這四個國家是瓜地馬拉、貝里斯、巴拉圭，以及聖文森及格瑞那丁。
他們說台灣做得很好。
台灣正在減少污染並發展乾淨的科技。
台灣外交部很高興。
它說台灣想幫助世界解決氣候問題。

paragraphs: Taiwan thanked four of its diplomatic allies on Saturday for supporting it at COP31, the United Nations climate conference held in Türkiye this month.
Because Taiwan is not a member of the United Nations, it cannot take part in the official talks. Instead, its allies spoke up for it during the high-level part of the meeting on November 17 and 18.

The four countries were Guatemala, Belize, Paraguay, and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines. They praised Taiwan's work on carbon pricing, cutting greenhouse gases, adapting to climate change and developing clean technology.

Guatemala's environment minister said these efforts showed that Taiwan was serious about becoming climate neutral. Saint Vincent and the Grenadines said a move to clean energy is not fair if small island nations or willing partners are left out.
Paraguay said in a written statement that Taiwan should be allowed to join the conference's activities. Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs thanked the four allies for speaking up.
sentZh: 台灣週六感謝四個邦交國，在本月於土耳其舉行的聯合國氣候會議COP31上支持台灣。
由於台灣不是聯合國會員，無法參與正式談判。
因此，友邦在11月17日和18日會議的高階會議期間為台灣發聲。
這四個國家是瓜地馬拉、貝里斯、巴拉圭，以及聖文森及格瑞那丁。
他們稱讚台灣在碳定價、減少溫室氣體、調適氣候變遷和發展潔淨科技方面的努力。
瓜地馬拉環境部長說，這些努力顯示台灣認真追求氣候中和。
聖文森及格瑞那丁表示，如果小島國家或有意願的夥伴被排除在外，轉向潔淨能源就不公平。
巴拉圭在書面聲明中說，台灣應獲准參與大會的活動。
台灣外交部感謝四個友邦仗義執言。

paragraphs: Taiwan's government has thanked four diplomatic allies for backing its participation in global climate governance at COP31, the latest United Nations climate summit, which took place in Türkiye.

Excluded from the United Nations system, Taiwan relies on friendly nations to raise its case. Guatemala, Belize, Paraguay, and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines did so during the conference's high-level segment on November 17 and 18.

According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the four allies recognised Taiwan's progress in carbon pricing, emissions reduction, climate adaptation and clean technology. Guatemala's environment minister, Edwin Castellanos, said these measures demonstrated Taiwan's commitment to climate neutrality.

Saint Vincent and the Grenadines argued that an energy transition cannot be fair or inclusive if it leaves small island states behind or shuts out willing partners. Paraguay, in a written statement, said Taiwan had contributed to mitigation, adaptation and international cooperation and should be allowed to take part.
The ministry said the statements showed growing recognition of what Taiwan can offer, and it repeated that the island has made measurable progress towards sustainable development.
sentZh: 台灣政府感謝四個邦交國在土耳其舉行的最新一屆聯合國氣候峰會COP31上，支持台灣參與全球氣候治理。
台灣被排除在聯合國體系之外，只能依靠友好國家替它發聲。
瓜地馬拉、貝里斯、巴拉圭，以及聖文森及格瑞那丁在11月17日和18日大會的高階會議中這麼做了。
根據外交部，四個友邦肯定台灣在碳定價、減量、氣候調適和潔淨科技上的進展。
瓜地馬拉環境部長艾德溫・卡斯特亞諾斯說，這些措施展現了台灣對氣候中和的承諾。
聖文森及格瑞那丁主張，如果能源轉型把小島國家拋在後面或把有意願的夥伴拒於門外，就不可能公平或具包容性。
巴拉圭在書面聲明中表示，台灣在減緩、調適和國際合作上都有貢獻，應獲准參與。
外交部說，這些聲明顯示各國越來越肯定台灣能做出的貢獻，並重申台灣在永續發展上已取得可衡量的進展。

paragraphs: Taiwan has expressed gratitude to four of its remaining diplomatic allies for championing its inclusion in international climate negotiations at COP31, the United Nations climate summit hosted by Türkiye.

Shut out of the United Nations framework, Taipei depends on sympathetic governments to advocate on its behalf. Guatemala, Belize, Paraguay, and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines took up that role during the summit's high-level segment, held on November 17 and 18.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs said the allies had acknowledged Taiwan's achievements in carbon pricing, greenhouse gas mitigation, climate adaptation and clean technology. Guatemala's environment minister, Edwin Castellanos, described these policies as evidence of a genuine commitment to climate neutrality.

Saint Vincent and the Grenadines made a broader point, contending that no energy transition can be considered just or inclusive if it abandons small island developing states or excludes partners willing to contribute. Paraguay, meanwhile, submitted a written statement urging that Taiwan be permitted to participate in the conference's activities.

The ministry welcomed what it called mounting recognition of Taiwan's potential contribution, insisting that the island had accumulated valuable expertise and achieved measurable results in sustainable development.
sentZh: 台灣向四個僅存的邦交國表達感謝，感謝它們在土耳其主辦的聯合國氣候峰會COP31上，力挺台灣納入國際氣候談判。
台北被排除在聯合國架構之外，仰賴友善的政府代為倡議。
瓜地馬拉、貝里斯、巴拉圭，以及聖文森及格瑞那丁在11月17日和18日舉行的峰會高階會議中擔起了這個角色。
外交部表示，友邦肯定了台灣在碳定價、溫室氣體減緩、氣候調適和潔淨科技上的成就。
瓜地馬拉環境部長艾德溫・卡斯特亞諾斯形容這些政策是真心致力於氣候中和的證據。
聖文森及格瑞那丁提出更廣泛的觀點，主張任何能源轉型若拋棄小島嶼開發中國家，或排除願意貢獻的夥伴，都不能算是公正或包容的。
同時，巴拉圭提交書面聲明，敦促允許台灣參與大會的活動。
外交部歡迎它所說的各界對台灣潛在貢獻日益增加的肯定，並強調台灣已累積寶貴的專業知識，在永續發展上取得可衡量的成果。

paragraphs: Taiwan's foreign ministry has publicly thanked four diplomatic allies for advocating its participation in global climate governance at COP31, the most recent round of United Nations climate negotiations, convened in Türkiye.

Owing to its exclusion from the United Nations system, Taiwan is unable to send official delegates and must instead rely on sympathetic states to articulate its position. Guatemala, Belize, Paraguay, and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines performed that function during the summit's high-level segment on November 17 and 18.

In their remarks, the allies commended Taiwan's track record in carbon pricing, emissions reduction, climate adaptation and the development of clean technology. Guatemala's environment minister, Edwin Castellanos, characterised these initiatives as a clear indication of the island's commitment to achieving climate neutrality.

Saint Vincent and the Grenadines framed the issue in terms of equity, maintaining that an energy transition could hardly be described as just if it marginalised small island developing states or excluded willing contributors. Paraguay echoed this sentiment in a written submission, asserting that Taiwan ought to be permitted to engage in the conference's activities.

For its part, the ministry interpreted the statements as evidence of growing international acknowledgement of Taiwan's capabilities, emphasising that the island had made quantifiable progress in mitigation, adaptation and sustainable development.
sentZh: 台灣外交部公開感謝四個邦交國，在土耳其召開的最新一輪聯合國氣候談判COP31上，倡議台灣參與全球氣候治理。
由於被排除在聯合國體系之外，台灣無法派遣正式代表，只能仰賴友好國家闡述其立場。
瓜地馬拉、貝里斯、巴拉圭，以及聖文森及格瑞那丁在11月17日和18日的峰會高階會議中發揮了這項作用。
友邦在發言中讚揚台灣在碳定價、減量、氣候調適和發展潔淨科技方面的成績。
瓜地馬拉環境部長艾德溫・卡斯特亞諾斯將這些措施形容為台灣致力實現氣候中和的明確跡象。
聖文森及格瑞那丁從公平的角度看待這個議題，主張若能源轉型讓小島嶼開發中國家邊緣化或排除有意貢獻者，就很難稱得上公正。
巴拉圭在書面意見中呼應這個看法，主張應允許台灣參與大會的活動。
外交部則將這些聲明解讀為國際社會越來越認可台灣能力的證據，並強調台灣在減緩、調適和永續發展上取得了可量化的進展。
